label: Gabija system
definition: A phage defense system in which an organism possesses a Gabija locus encoding GajA and GajB proteins that assemble into an antiphage complex and inhibit bacteriophage replication.
exact_synonyms: Gabija anti-phage defense system|Gabija anti-phage defence system
observations: Gabija branch under phage defense system; distinct from individual gajA or gajB genes, GajA or GajB proteins, the GajAB protein complex, source database rows naming one Gabija locus, phage-encoded anti-Gabija inhibitors such as Gad1, mechanistic nucleotide-depletion or DNA-cleavage subactivities, and other antiphage systems such as BREX, DISARM, CBASS, phosphorothioate defense, CRISPR-Cas, and abortive infection families.
